theorems.statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Ps : Fin q → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → BoundaryVanishes C → (∀ i, Module.finrank ℝ (Ps i) = 2) → (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Ps i ⊓ Ps j = ⊥) → (∀ x ∈ C.support, x ≠ 0 → ∃ i, x ∈ Ps i) → ∃ m : ℕ, HasMassDensity C 0 m
